chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
Every small thing that is contented upon, suffices.

key_terms.مُقْتَصَرٍ: Contented upon / satisfied with a small amount

ai.seo_question: What does it mean to be content with little in Shia ethics?
ai.summary: In this concise maxim from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) defines sufficiency not by material accumulation but by the internal state of contentment (qana'ah). This teaching aligns with the Shia ethical emphasis on detachment from worldly excess, suggesting that true richness lies in the heart's satisfaction rather than external wealth.

en.sayed-ali-raza: 395. Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him, said:
Every small thing that is contented upon, suffices.
